[SWS_DM_01745] Behavior on failed transport protocol initialization
⌈
If a ara::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolHandler::Ini-
tialize returns kInitializeFailed, the DM shall stop the initialization process of
the transport protocol and call no further methods on that ara::diag::uds_trans-
port::UdsTransportProtocolHandler.
⌋
